import { type PropertyValues } from 'lit';
import { KrdsElement } from '../base.js';
/** Native top-layer dialog preserves same-root names and inherited theme tokens. */
export declare class Modal extends KrdsElement {
    static properties: {
        open: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
        };
        defaultOpen: {
            attribute: string;
            type: BooleanConstructor;
        };
        title: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        description: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        body: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        actions: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        showCloseButton: {
            attribute: string;
            type: BooleanConstructor;
        };
        closeOnOutsideClick: {
            attribute: string;
            type: BooleanConstructor;
        };
        initialFocusId: {
            attribute: string;
        };
        returnFocusId: {
            attribute: string;
        };
    };
    open: boolean | undefined;
    defaultOpen: boolean | undefined;
    title: string;
    description: string;
    body: unknown;
    actions: unknown;
    showCloseButton: boolean;
    closeOnOutsideClick: boolean;
    initialFocusId: string | undefined;
    returnFocusId: string | undefined;
    private state;
    private opener;
    private active;
    private activeDialog;
    private outside;
    constructor();
    get isOpen(): boolean;
    requestOpen(open: boolean): void;
    willUpdate(_changed: PropertyValues): void;
    updated(): void;
    private focusables;
    private usable;
    private cleanup;
    disconnectedCallback(): void;
    private key;
    render(): import("lit").TemplateResult<1>;
}
